summary: Iteration 67 backend testing complete. All 15 new tests + 11 regression tests passed (26/26 = 100%). Validated: (1) POST /api/travel/generate-event correctly returns cd_prueba=10 for gran_camino/camino_mayor/camino_menor, cd_prueba=15 for campo_abierto, cd_prueba=20 for muy_dificil/desalentador; terreno_categoria field present; resolucion.cd matches cd_prueba. (2) desventaja_estacion=true for 'invierno' and 'otono', false for 'verano'/'primavera'. (3) PATCH /api/characters/{id}/equipment/carry accepts source='equipo_ocupacion' and moves items between character and mount, persisting portado_por correctly. (4) PATCH /api/characters/{id}/equipment/toggle-active accepts source='equipo_ocupacion'. (5) GET /api/characters/{id}/weight-summary works for Xalan (id=208ab2df...). (6) Regression: all iteration 66 tests still pass (multi-mount CRUD, ropa, weight-summary monturas_detalle, mounted+mount_id, travel calculate-journey, rest endpoints).

minor.issue: Endpoint uses query parameters (terreno, estacion, tipo_tierra) instead of JSON body. Frontend callers must use ?terreno=...&estacion=... format. Not a bug per se but inconsistent with most POSTs in the codebase that use JSON bodies. Recommend documenting clearly or migrating to a Pydantic body model.

action_items: (Optional) Consider switching POST /api/travel/generate-event to a Pydantic JSON body for consistency with the rest of the API (currently query params).
Frontend Shadow save logic (CHA per character before applying Sombra) was NOT tested as it is frontend-only per the request — main agent should self-verify via UI.
